title: Text 1
subtitle: 气候变化教学之争（得克萨斯州）

sentences.en: The weather in Texas may have cooled since the recent extreme heat, but the temperature will be high at the State Board of Education meeting in Austin this month as officials debate how climate change is taught in Texas schools.
sentences.zh: 自最近的极端高温以来，得克萨斯州的天气可能已经凉快下来，但本月在奥斯汀举行的州教育委员会会议上气氛仍会“高温”不下，因为官员们正在争论得州学校应如何教授气候变化。

sentences.en: Pat Hardy, who sympathises with views of the energy sector, is resisting proposed changes to science standards for pre-teen pupils.
sentences.zh: 帕特·哈迪同情能源部门的观点，正在抵制针对低龄学童的科学课程标准提案修改。

sentences.en: These could emphasise the primacy of human activity in recent climate change and encourage discussion of mitigation measures.
sentences.zh: 这些修改会强调人类活动在近期气候变化中的主导作用，并鼓励就减缓措施展开讨论。

sentences.en: Most scientists and experts sharply dispute Hardy's views.
sentences.zh: 大多数科学家和专家强烈反对哈迪的观点。

sentences.en: "They casually dismiss the career work of scholars and scientists as just another misguided opinion." says Dan Quinn, senior communications strategist at the Texas Freedom Network, a non-profit group that monitors public education,
sentences.zh: “他们随意将学者和科学家毕生的事业成果贬低为又一个错误的观点。”德克萨斯自由网络的高级传播策略师丹·奎因说，该组织是一个监督公共教育的非营利机构。

sentences.en: "What millions of Texas kids learn in their public schools is determined too often by the political ideology of partisan board members, rather than facts and sound scholarship."
sentences.zh: “数百万得州孩子公立学校所学的内容，常常是由党派出身的委员会成员们的政治意识形态决定的，而不是由事实和严谨的学术决定的。”

sentences.en: Such debates reflect fierce discussions across the US and around the world, as researchers, policymakers, teachers and students step up demands for a greater focus on teaching about the facts of climate change in schools.
sentences.zh: 这样的争论反映出全美乃至世界各地激烈的讨论，因为研究人员、政策制定者、教师和学生都在加大呼声，要求学校更注重教授气候变化的科学事实。

sentences.en: A study last year by the National Center for Science Education, a non-profit group of scientists and teachers, looking at how state public schools across the country address climate change in science classes, gave barely half of US states a grade B+ or higher.
sentences.zh: 美国科学教育中心去年开展的一项研究——该中心是一个由科学家和教师组成的非营利组织——审视了全国各州公立学校在科学课上如何处理气候变化，结果只有勉强一半的美国州获得了B+或更高的评分。

sentences.en: Among the 10 worst performers were some of the most populous states, including Texas, which was given the lowest grade (F) and has a disproportionate influence because its textbooks are widely sold elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 在表现最差的十个州中，有一些是人口最多的州，包括得克萨斯州——它获得了最低等级（F），并且因其教材在其他地方被广泛销售而具有与其人口不相称的巨大影响力。

sentences.en: Glenn Branch, the centre's deputy director, cautions that setting state-level science standards is only one limited benchmark in a country that decentralises decisions to local school boards.
sentences.zh: 该中心副主任格伦·布兰奇提醒说，在一个把决策权下放到地方学校董事会的国家里，制定州级科学课程标准只是一个有限的衡量基准。

sentences.en: Even if a state is considered a high performer in its science standards, "that does not mean it will be taught", he says.
sentences.zh: 他说，即使一个州的科学标准被认为表现优异，“那也不意味着这些标准会真正落实到教学中。”

sentences.en: Another issue is that, while climate change is well integrated into some subjects and at some ages–such as earth and space sciences in high schools–it is not as well represented in curricula for younger children and in subjects that are more widely taught, such as biology and chemistry.
sentences.zh: 另一个问题是，虽然气候变化已很好地融入了某些学科和某些年龄段——例如高中的地球与空间科学——但在更年幼孩子的课程，以及在开设更广的科目（如生物和化学）中，它却没有得到同样充分的体现。

sentences.en: It is also less prominent in many social studies courses.
sentences.zh: 在许多社会研究课程中，气候变化的内容也不那么突出。

sentences.en: Branch points out that, even if a growing number of official guidelines and textbooks reflect scientific consensus on climate change, unofficial educational materials that convey more slanted perspectives are being distributed to teachers.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇指出，尽管越来越多的官方指南和教材反映了关于气候变化的科学共识，但传达更偏颇观点的非官方教学材料正在被分发到教师手中。

sentences.en: They include materials sponsored by libertarian think-tanks and energy industry associations.
sentences.zh: 这些材料包括由自由意志主义智库和能源行业协会赞助的材料。

questions.stem: In Paragraph 1, the weather in Texas is mentioned to ______.

options.A: forecast a policy shift in Texas schools
options.B: stress the consequences of climate change
options.C: indicate the atmosphere at the board meeting
options.D: draw the public's attention to energy shortages

questions.analysis: 细节题。题干关键词 the weather in Texas 可定位到第一段第①句：前半句说得州的天气已从极端高温中凉快下来，后半句转折指出“but the temperature will be high at the State Board of Education meeting”（但州教育委员会会议的气氛将非常热烈），用“temperature”一词把天气与会议氛围进行类比。C 项 indicate the atmosphere at the board meeting（表明委员会会议的氛围）符合该句的作用，故选 C。

questions.stem: What does Quinn think of Hardy?

options.B: She denies the value of scientific work.
options.C: She shows no concern for pre-teens.

questions.analysis: 细节题。题干关键词 Quinn 定位到第三段，其引语指出：“They casually dismiss the career work of scholars and scientists as just another misguided opinion.”（他们随意否定学者和科学家们的事业成果，将其仅仅看作又一个错误的观点）。句中 They 指代以 Hardy 为代表的反对者。B 项 She denies the value of scientific work（她否认科学工作的价值）是对该句的合理概括，故选 B。

questions.stem: The study mentioned in Paragraph 5 indicates that ______.

options.A: climate education is insufficient at state public schools
options.B: policy makers have little drive for science education
options.C: Texas is reluctant to rewrite its science textbooks
options.D: environmental teaching in some states lacks supervision

questions.analysis: 细节题。题干核心是“the study … indicates that”，定位到第五段。研究结论是：全美只有勉强一半的州在气候变化教学上获得 B+ 或更高评分，而表现最差的十个州中又包含一些人口最多的州。这意味着有更多的美国学生没有接受足够的气候变化教育。A 项 climate education is insufficient at state public schools（各州公立学校的气候变化教育不足）是对此的合理推断，故选 A。

questions.stem: According to Branch, state-level science standards in the US ______.
questions.analysis: 细节题。题干关键词 Branch、state-level science standards 定位到第六段第①句：“setting state-level science standards is only one limited benchmark”（制定州级科学课程标准只是一个有限的基准）。C 项 have limited influence（影响有限）是对 only one limited benchmark 的同义替换，故选 C。

questions.stem: It is implied in the last paragraph that climate change teaching in some schools ______.

options.D: can be swayed by external forces

questions.analysis: 推断题。最后一段指出：即便官方指南和教材反映了科学共识，但传达更偏颇观点的非官方教学材料（unofficial educational materials）正在被分发到教师手中，其中包括自由意志主义智库和能源行业协会赞助的材料。非官方材料并非公立教育体系所制作，说明外部力量可能影响学校的气候变化教学。D 项 can be swayed by external forces（可能受外部力量左右）是对此的合理推断，故选 D。
